data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/audit-review-defenses.sh so all RED tests pass.

**Why**: Provides the deterministic auditor that SC-2/SC-3/SC-4 disposition work depends on.

**Scope**: Single new script. Must: find REVIEW-DEFENSE via word-boundary match (sg preferred, grep fallback); parse referenced tickets/artifacts from comment body; probe artifact existence; probe ticket status via dso ticket show; classify defense_kind by file location and surrounding test annotations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- plugins/dso/scripts/audit-review-defenses.sh exists, executable, has shebang and 'set -euo pipefail'
- All RED tests pass (GREEN)
- Script uses 'command -v sg' guard with grep fallback per CLAUDE.md
- Script handles missing tickets gracefully (status=unknown, no crash)
- Pre-existing test suite still passes
data.title: GREEN: Implement audit-review-defenses.sh to pass RED tests
